name: Note reader
description: Shows the first lines of a text file and looks up your saved notes. Needs the files.read and memory.read permissions, which you grant one by one.

tools.name: file_head
tools.description: Show the first lines of a text file the user names (needs the files.read permission).

tools.name: my_notes
tools.description: Look up the notes the user saved with 'remember' (needs the memory.read permission).
